items.title: PPL Reports Soon: How Has The Stock Reacted To Past Earnings?
items.summary: PPL (NYSE:PPL) is scheduled to report its earnings on Friday, November 6, 2026. The company has a market value of about $26.9 billion. Over the last twelve months it generated $9.4 billion in revenue and $2.3 billion in operating profit, with net income of $1.3 billion.

items.title: Southern Co (SO) (Q3 2026) Earnings Call Highlights: Soaring Data Center Demand and Raised Guidance
items.summary: Southern Co (SO) beat Q3 estimates with $1.94 adjusted EPS, lifted full-year guidance to $4.70, and secured 21 gigawatts of large load contracts as data center usage jumped 59%.
